## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Sanary-sur-Mer, France. It starts at 131 Avenue du Pont d'Aran.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Come face-to-face with nearly 300 creatures from 80 different species at the ZOA Park. From the playful marmosets to the elusive ocelots, from the chatty Senegal parrots to the flamboyant flamingos, or from the sturdy tortoises to the white-throated monitor lizards, the park promises a surprise at every turn!
>
> ZOA began as a botanical garden, and over the years, has sprouted an incredible variety of flora. Whether you're a fan of Mediterranean greens, tropical blooms, or cacti, the park's greenhouses and rock gardens are a must-visit.
>
> And if, like bees to flowers, you're drawn to the vibrant blossoms, you're in for a treat with bougainvillea, bird of paradise, and pomegranate trees.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.14. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 79 ratings and 34 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
